headword: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A professional service company that helps people move their belongings from one residence to another. In Japan, moving companies offer various service levels from basic transport to full packing and unpacking.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}に{頼|たの}む。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}の{見積|みつ}もりを{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got a quote from the moving company.

examples.japanese: 3{月|がつ}は{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}が{忙|いそが}しいので、{料金|りょうきん}が{高|たか}くなる。
examples.english: Moving companies are busy in March, so prices go up.

notes:
A compound of {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し (moving house) and {業者|ぎょうしゃ} (service provider/company). In Japan, the fiscal and academic year starts in April, making March the peak moving season with significantly higher prices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}に{依頼|いらい}する: to request a moving company's services
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}の{見積|みつ}もり: moving company estimate/quote
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}を{比較|ひかく}する: to compare moving companies

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, it is common to get quotes from multiple moving companies and negotiate. Many companies offer different service tiers: basic ({荷物|にもつ}の{運搬|うんぱん}のみ, transport only), standard ({梱包|こんぽう}+{運搬|うんぱん}, packing and transport), and premium ({梱包|こんぽう}+{運搬|うんぱん}+{開梱|かいこん}, full service including unpacking).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {運送|うんそう}{会社|がいしゃ}: transport/shipping company — handles goods transport in general, not specifically household moves
